data.one_liner: Flutter widgets to layout content around a foldable device’s hinge and strip
data.what_it_does: Provides FoldScaffold, FoldSplitView, FoldAnchor and FoldBridge to position navigation, split panes and dialogs relative to a fold or strip. It preserves widget state across folding and handles insets and keyboard placement.
use_when: You need to support iPhone Duo or other foldable devices
Your app already defines its own navigation and content widgets
You want state to survive folding without custom logic
avoid_when: You need a fully themed platform UI like adaptive_platform_ui
strengths: Supports dialogs and sheets in the correct half
Works on Android, iOS, web, desktop
weaknesses: Requires iOS 27.1 SDK for full functionality
Only works on iPhone Duo for fold data; other foldables rely on Flutter’s displayFeatures
Needs manual wrapping with FoldBridge on iOS
data.setup_notes: Wrap the root widget with FoldBridge on iOS, target iOS 15+, use Xcode 27.1 SDK, ensure Flutter 3.41+ and no UIRequiresFullScreen. No build_runner needed.
